description: Our team is tackling the 'Planet X and SPHEREx' challenge by building an interactive web tool to visualize our changing universe. We are transforming SPHEREx’s massive near-infrared sky survey data into an intuitive, public-facing platform. By making it easy to track shifting celestial objects like comets, asteroids, and the hypothetical Planet X over time, we aim to democratize astronomy and empower anyone to join the cosmic hunt!
